Topics covered in this PDF

BHIC-132 (History of India from c. 300 CE to 1206) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Gupta art and literature, theories of Rajput origin, Pallava art and temple architecture, the Harshvardhan empire, land in the early medieval period
  • Local administration Ur and Nadu, Pallava-Pandya conflicts, painting, women in politics or administration, decline of the Bhakti movement

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: three assignments, answer all questions, marks 100, assignment code BHIC-132/ASST/TMA/2026-2027. Assignment I: two questions of 20 marks (about 500 words each). Assignment II: three questions of 10 marks (about 250 words each). Assignment III: five questions of 6 marks (about 100 words each)

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
